verdict.rationale: Moneybird is accounting software, so drafting and posting journal entries through the API is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows a general REST API, MCP and CLI channels, plus contact endpoints, but nothing documents a journal-entry endpoint or a draft/review queue for an accountant. Generic API access does not cover this specific capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent draft and post journal entries via the API and leave them in a review queue for my accountant
